interfaces.what: optical LGA16 module 6.4000 +/- 0.030 x 3.0300 +/- 0.030 x 1.5000 +/- 0.050 mm, corners 4 x R0.0750, solder-mask-to-pad 0.0180 +/- 0.010. Substrate 6.2000 x 2.8300 mm carrying 16 lands 0.5000 +/- 0.030 on a 0.7500 +/- 0.030 mm NON-CUMULATIVE pitch in three rows (A1-A7, B1/B4/B7, C1-C7). The frame is the module's MECHANICAL centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane, +z out of the board). The drawing states the OPTICAL centre separately: it is offset 0.1000 mm from the mechanical centre, and the Rx aperture is Ø0.5100 +/- 0.030 mm. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning. DISCRIMINATOR AGAINST THE L8CX, measured on both vendor drawings in the same session: the two share the 6.4000 x 3.0300 mm footprint EXACTLY and differ only in HEIGHT — 1.5000 +/- 0.050 here against 1.7500 +/- 0.050 on the VL53L8CX (DS14161 Rev 12 Figure 26, page 31/45). 0.2500 mm is a caliper-sized difference, so a real unit settles which generation part:microduck-tof-module carries.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWINGS: STMicroelectronics VL53L5CX datasheet DS13754 Rev 13, section 8 'Outline drawings', Figure 21 'Outline drawing (1/4)' PAGE 26 of 40 (envelope, height, aperture) and Figure 22 'Outline drawing (2/4)' PAGE 27 of 40 (substrate and land grid) — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
